title: Jupyter Dyno settings
description: Settings to use when solving a DSGE model

preserve-scroll-position.title: Preserve scroll position
preserve-scroll-position.description: If enabled, the viewer will attempt to preserve its scroll position after re-rendering.

refresh-delay.title: Refresh Delay (ms)
refresh-delay.description: Time without edits before the preview is recomputed.

error-refresh-delay.title: Error Refresh Delay (ms)
error-refresh-delay.description: When the recomputed report contains an error, wait until this long after the last edit before displaying it, so that errors don't flash while typing. Successful reports are displayed as soon as they are ready.

modfile-preprocessor.title: Modfile Preprocessor
modfile-preprocessor.description: How to preprocess the mod file before solving the model.

kernel-restart.title: Restart Kernel on Solve
kernel-restart.description: Restart the kernel everytime the model is solved (for development purpose).

output_type.title: Output Type
output_type.description: Type of output to generate. 'myst' renders the MyST report to HTML in the kernel.

display_graph.title: Display Graph
display_graph.description: If enabled, graph outputs are displayed in Dyno reports.

show-toolbar.title: Show Preview Toolbar
show-toolbar.description: If enabled, the Dyno preview panel shows a toolbar with Re-run, Clear and Options buttons.

show-options-panel.title: Show Options Panel
show-options-panel.description: If enabled, the 'Dyno Options' panel is added to the right sidebar.
